node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-color remainder router
node.statement: After the cubic 3+3 exclusion, exact three-color cubic packets have profile 3+2+1 or 2+2+2. Cyclic color rotation reduces the 56 unordered color triples to seven representatives; each packet satisfies the h=7 conic, the six-coefficient remainder L | product_(j in T)(E-omega^j), three nonempty-fiber resultants, and its norm-color equation.
node.notes: Exact bounded necessary router only. No one of the seven orbit systems is declared empty, and four-or-more-color cubic packets remain outside its scope.
